items.source: Parent advisor interface for all advisors.
items.translation: 所有顾问的家长顾问界面。

items.source: Advisor for execution flows ultimately resulting in a call to an AI model
items.translation: 负责最终导致调用 AI 模型的执行流程的顾问。

items.source: Advisor for execution flows ultimately resulting in a streaming call to an AI model.
items.translation: 负责执行流的顾问，最终将导致对 AI 模型的流式调用。

items.source: Base advisor that implements common aspects of the CallAdvisor and StreamAdvisor, reducing the boilerplate code needed to implement an advisor.
items.translation: 基础顾问，实现了 CallAdvisor 和 StreamAdvisor 的通用方面，从而减少了实现顾问所需的样板代码。

items.source:
Defines the context for executing a chain of advisors as part of processing a chat
request.
items.translation: 定义在作为聊天请求处理的一部分执行顾问链时的上下文。

items.source: A chain of StreamAdvisor instances orchestrating the execution of a ChatClientRequest on the next StreamAdvisor in the chain.
items.translation: 一系列StreamAdvisor实例负责编排对下一个链中StreamAdvisor的ChatClientRequest执行。

items.source: A chain of CallAdvisor instances orchestrating the execution of a ChatClientRequest on the next CallAdvisor in the chain.
items.translation: 一系列CallAdvisor实例负责编排对下一个链中CallAdvisor的ChatClientRequest执行。

items.source: Marker interface for advisors that own the memory lifecycle.
items.translation: 拥有内存生命周期的顾问的标记接口。

items.source: Base interface for chat memory advisors.
items.translation: 聊天记忆顾问的基础接口。

items.source:
A base interface for advisor chains that can be used to chain multiple advisors
together, both for call and stream advisors.
items.translation: 用于将多个顾问（包括调用型顾问和流式顾问）串联在一起的顾问链基础接口。

items.source: Builder for creating a BaseAdvisorChain instance.
items.translation: 用于创建BaseAdvisorChain实例的构建器。

items.source: Marker interface for advisors that own the tool-call lifecycle.
items.translation: 拥有工具调用生命周期的顾问的标记接口。

items.translation: 提供用于建议聊天客户端的类。

items.source: Provides the API for chat client advisors.
items.translation: 为聊天客户端顾问提供 API。

items.source: Tool Search Tool Advisor package for dynamic tool discovery and search capabilities.
items.translation: 工具搜索工具顾问包，用于动态工具发现与搜索功能。

items.source: Spring AI chat client advisors package.
items.translation: Spring AI 聊天客户端顾问包。

items.source: Provides classes for observing chat data.
items.translation: 提供用于观察聊天数据的类。

items.source: Test support classes for ChatClient advisor integration tests.
items.translation: ChatClient 顾问集成测试的测试支持类。
